## Featured Projects

### CodeFlow
Paste code and a fully local model draws an animated control-flow flowchart, with every node wired back to the exact source lines it came from. Hover a node to highlight its lines, click to jump-and-edit, or move the cursor over a line to light up the matching node. Built for the Hugging Face Build Small Hackathon 2026 (hosted by Gradio; backed by OpenBMB, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Modal, Cohere, JetBrains, and Black Forest Labs).
* **Model:** A LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, a Mixture-of-Experts coder with only ~3.3B active params per token, run on CPU via llama.cpp. The sparse activation is what makes a 30B-class model viable without a GPU. Served as a ~3-bit GGUF (~16 GB).
* **Training data:** 2,400 synthetic code-to-flowchart pairs across Python, JavaScript, C, and C++, spanning 22 control-flow patterns. Every example is correct-by-construction (targets validated with `compile()`, `node --check`, and real compilers), with labels using plain-English paraphrasing rather than raw code to fix the base model's main formatting failure mode.
* **Reliability:** A strict system prompt (banned vocabulary, few-shot examples, a `<thinking>` reasoning channel) plus a server-side regex sanitizer. The model emits a `<linemap>` validated against the source, which powers the node-to-code linking.
* **Tech:** Gradio, llama.cpp, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (MoE), LoRA fine-tuning, ~3-bit GGUF.
* **Live demo:** [https://huggingface.co/spaces/build-small-hackathon/CodeFlow](https://huggingface.co/spaces/build-small-hackathon/CodeFlow)
* **Demo video:** [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R5GbpN9FVxo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R5GbpN9FVxo)
* **Build journal:** [https://huggingface.co/blog/build-small-hackathon/codeflow-field-notes](https://huggingface.co/blog/build-small-hackathon/codeflow-field-notes)
* **Fine-tuned model:** [https://huggingface.co/build-small-hackathon/codeflow-qwen-3-finetuning](https://huggingface.co/build-small-hackathon/codeflow-qwen-3-finetuning)
* **Agent traces dataset:** [https://huggingface.co/datasets/build-small-hackathon/codeflow-agent-traces](https://huggingface.co/datasets/build-small-hackathon/codeflow-agent-traces)

### Support Ticket Triage Agent
An intelligent agent utilizing RAG to automate customer support workflows for companies like Anthropic and HackerRank.
* **Tech:** Python, RAG frameworks, Vector Databases, OpenAI API.

### DebateSearch
An AI-integrated search platform democratizing access to competitive debate information via custom index optimization.
* **Tech:** JavaScript, SQL, Neon Databases, Vercel, Cloudflare.

## Research & Replications

### Neural Machine Translation (NMT)
End-to-end Hindi-English translator with a scratch-built Transformer architecture.
* **Key Features:** Custom SentencePiece tokenizer, RoPE, Beam Search, and Transformer blocks.
* **Link:** [View on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Rishi-Jain-27/hindi-english-translator)

### Reinforcement Learning (RL) Suite
Implementation of foundational RL algorithms from scratch for complex environments.
* **Bipedal Walker:** Implemented SAC, DDPG, and TD3 for Easy/Hardcore environments.
* **Lunar Lander:** Implemented PPO and REINFORCE to navigate complex physics.
* **Flappy Bird:** Implemented DQL with Dueling and Double DQN extensions.
* **Blackjack:** Implemented GRPO and RPO from scratch in PyTorch on Gymnasium's Blackjack-v1. [GitHub](https://github.com/Rishi-Jain-27/blackjack-rl)
* **chessMAPPO:** Implemented Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO) self-play between white and black agents, built on python-chess and PettingZoo. [GitHub](https://github.com/Rishi-Jain-27/chess-marl)
